title: Stats cache servers
enable: Route stats lookups through cache servers
hint: Battle-stats lookups try your cache servers first and fall back to the direct route on a miss — one player's slow fetch becomes everyone's cache hit.
addInvalid: Server URL must start with https:// (plain http only for 127.0.0.1/localhost)
autodiscoverHint: When on, verified community nodes from the official broadcast list are used after your own list. One click here turns it off.
discoveredNone: No community nodes are currently verified.
saveFailed: Failed to save the cache-server settings: {message}
selfhostBody: Legions and individuals can self-deploy a WoWSP cache server — members' lookups then share one cache.
selfhostPlatforms: Deployable on a VPS or LAN box via Docker, or to Vercel's edge with one click.
